column10: 1","Access Bank Plc Audited Annual Reports and Financial Statements 2015-2022 from official investor relations website and Nigerian Exchange (NGX) filings. Key sources include 2022 Annual Report [f67748], 2021 Annual Report [447dcc], 2020 Annual Report [0e0da5], 2019 Annual Report [04539c], 2018 Annual Report [780738], 2017 Annual Report [a782b4], 2016 Annual Report [d24e86], and 2015 Annual Report [42178c].","All data extracted are bank-level (standalone) figures for Access Bank Plc. IFRS 9 was adopted in 2018 (IFRS9_D=1), while 2015-2017 are IAS 39 (IFRS9_D=0). Gross Loans are reported before the deduction of impairment allowances (ECL/LLP). Auditor remains PwC for the entire period 2015-2022. No going concern paragraphs were issued by the auditors (GC_t=0). ln(TA) is the natural log of Total Assets in ₦'m. ROA, ECL/Loans, and LEV are calculated based on standalone PAT, Total Assets, Total Liabilities, and Gross Loans. Data for 2019 includes the business combination with Diamond Bank Plc [04539c]. 2022 figures reflect the bank-level performance before the full transition to the HoldCo structure in all reported notes [f67748]."

1","Sterling Bank Plc Audited Annual Reports and Financial Statements (2015-2022) sourced via the bank's Investor Relations website (sterling.ng) and the Nigerian Exchange (NGX) Group's document library. Specific documents accessed: 2022 AFS [9cdd52], 2021 AFS [a08dc9], 2020 AFS [4fdb9a], 2019 AR [c69f11], 2018 AR [1f9d62, b1bb91], 2017 AR [15548a, 9cd772], 2016 AR [2f24db], 2015 AR [af43bb].","Data represents the standalone (bank-level) performance of Sterling Bank Plc (excluding subsidiaries like Sterling Investment Management Plc). The transition to IFRS 9 occurred in 2018. For 2018, the impairment net figure is recorded as a write-back (income) as reported in the Income Statement. For 2015, Gross Loans and Provisions were calculated from Note 19. All ratios were calculated based on the standalone balance sheet and income statement figures provided in the audited reports. All CAR values were sourced from the Capital Management notes in the respective annual reports. Natural log of Total Assets (lnTA) was calculated using the Total Assets in N'm. Auditor names were verified from the Independent Auditor's Report section of each year's statement. No going concern paragraphs (ISA 570) were issued for any year under review."

1","Unity Bank Plc Annual Reports (2016, 2018, 2020, 2022) accessed via Unity Bank Investor Relations and NGX Document Library.","The bank experienced significant capital deficiencies during the period, resulting in negative CAR and total equity, particularly from 2017 onwards [a2e75f, a9d68d, 1b6c52]. Auditors (KPMG) issued a 'Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern' (ISA 570) starting from 2019 [a9d68d, 1b6c52]. For 2015-2016, cumulative provision data was not explicitly stated in the financial highlights, but impairment charges were recorded [fc4a93]. ln(TA) is calculated as ln(Total Assets in ₦'m). CAR for 2017-2022 reflects the negative capital position as reported in the financial statements [a2e75f, a9d68d, 1b6c52]. 2017 PAT reflects a major loss due to legacy clean-up [a2e75f]. Gross Earnings for 2018 were significantly lower than 2017 due to the disposal of a large portion of the loan book to Frontier Management Services [a2e75f]. NPL ratios for later years are remarkably low or zero as reported in the bank's summaries [1b6c52, a9d68d, a2e75f]."
